scope: D34: single-Q spirals (IncommensurateStructure) and rotating-frame LSWT (Toth and Lake 2015).
api: IncommensurateStructure(model_ref, wave_vector, rotation_axis, directions) with planar(), from_lt(), to_spin_state(); solve_spiral_lswt(model, structure, conditions, geometry, settings) -> SpiralLSWTResult (rotating: LSWTResult with extra['frame'] = 'rotating'); spiral_structure_factor(result, q, temperature); spiral_energy, spiral_energy_gradient, refine_spiral, rotating_frame_model, symmetry_violations; LTWaveVector.amplitude.
method: Rotating-frame exchange J'(dn) = J R_n(2 pi q . dn) is translation invariant when every J commutes with rotations about n and h_a = g_a^T b is along n; the rotating-frame model on the primitive cell with state d_a is solved by solve_lswt. Models without that U(1) symmetry are rejected (single-Q spiral not stationary, k mixes with k +- 2Q). Lab-frame S(k, w) = sum_m R_m S'(k - m Q, w) R_m^dagger with the site phase exp(-i m Q . tau_i) of the cell-index convention; Q or 2Q in G raises NotImplementedError.

added.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/lswt/spir: solve_spiral_lswt, SpiralLSWTResult, rotating_frame_model, refine_spiral, spiral_energy(_gradient), symmetry_violations

findings: Triangular 120 deg as a spiral (Q = K): omega(k) equals 3JS sqrt((1 - g)(1 + 2g)) to 9e-15; on the same momenta the ground-state energy (2e-16), bands (5e-15), boson numbers and the full lab-frame S^{ab}(q, w) at t = 0 and 0.3 (1e-12) equal ordinary LSWT on the sqrt3 x sqrt3 supercell; Bragg intensities agree.

Incommensurate J1-J2 chains (J2/J1 = 0.4, Jy = -0.5): LT + refine_spiral give the analytic pitch to 9e-11 and omega(k) equals the Heisenberg spiral formula to 6e-15; the same spiral on a two-site cell gives the same energy and S(q, w).
DM spiral (FM J, D along the axis) and a cone in an axial field: analytic pitch and cone angle reproduced, and energies, bands and S(q, w) equal the 6 x 1 and 3 x 1 supercells to round-off.

Refusals: non-U(1) exchange and off-axis field (SpiralSymmetryError listing the terms), a pitch off the minimum (dE/dq warning and negative modes), lab-frame observables and topology given the rotating-frame result, collinear LT minima.

cases.model: triangular Heisenberg (120 deg as a spiral, Q = K)
square J1-J2 chains (J1 = 1, J2 = 0.4) with Jy = -0.5: incommensurate
ferromagnetic J = -1 with DM D = sqrt(3) along z (x bonds), Jy = -1
J1-J2 chains (J2 = 0.5, q = 1/3) in a field along the axis: cone
